summary: `app/sitemap.ts` publishes the public site as `/sitemap.xml` and `app/robots.ts` allows it, disallows `/admin`, `/dashboard` and `/api` and points at the sitemap; every URL is derived, never hand-listed.
reader_impact: A crawler is handed 44 public URLs on the QuizHub build and 39 on the AlignSynch one — every one a page that answers 200 — instead of finding the site by guessing.
